note: Defensive coaching additions to the English placement bank (placement-v1) for Spanish-speaking coaches. CEFR-inspired estimate, not an official certification. All people are fictional.

lines.speaker: mike
lines.text: Okay, ready position. Feet wide, knees bent, glove out front.
lines.es: Bien, posición de listo. Pies separados, rodillas dobladas, guante al frente.

lines.speaker: dave
lines.text: Your first step was late. Read it off the bat and go. And set your feet before you throw.
lines.es: Tu primer paso fue tarde. Lee la bola cuando sale del bate y arranca. Y planta los pies antes de tirar.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: Good rep. Your glove was out front, and that's exactly what we wanted. The only thing is you came up a little early, so the ball got under your glove. Let's do three more, and this time see it all the way into the glove.
lines.es: Buena repetición. Tenías el guante al frente, y eso es justo lo que queríamos. Lo único es que te levantaste un poco temprano, así que la bola se te pasó por debajo del guante. Hagamos tres más, y esta vez mira la bola hasta que entre en el guante.

lines.speaker: tyler
lines.text: Coach, I'm up next. Anything I should do on this ground ball?
lines.es: Coach, me toca a mí. ¿Algo que deba hacer en este roletazo?

lines.speaker: tyler
lines.text: Coach, what should I focus on during this drill?
lines.es: Coach, ¿en qué me debo enfocar durante este ejercicio?

items.prompt: A coach says: "Stay low." He means:
items.prompt_es: Un coach dice: "Stay low." Quiere decir:
options: Keep your body down; bend your knees.

items.prompt: Listen. Where should the glove be?
options: On the ground next to him

items.prompt: "Take it on the backhand" means: field the ball…
items.prompt_es: "Take it on the backhand" quiere decir: fildea la bola…
options: on your throwing-hand side, with the glove turned over

items.prompt: Listen. What should the player do before he throws?
items.prompt_es: Escucha. ¿Qué debe hacer el jugador antes de tirar?

items.prompt: Complete the explanation: "Get your feet under you, ___ your throw has something behind it."
items.prompt_es: Completa la explicación: "Pon los pies debajo de ti, ___ tu tiro tenga fuerza detrás."

items.prompt: Read the coach's note: "Shade him two steps toward the pull side. He hit almost every ground ball to that side last series." Why should the fielder move?
items.prompt_es: Lee la nota del coach. ¿Por qué debe moverse el fildeador?
options: The hitter hits most of his ground balls to that side.
The fielder needs a better throwing angle to first.
The hitter is fast, so the fielder must play closer.

items.prompt: Read: You have just explained a backhand drill to a young infielder. Which question checks his understanding best?
items.prompt_es: Lee: acabas de explicarle un ejercicio de revés a un infielder joven. ¿Qué pregunta comprueba mejor que entendió?
options: Can you show me what you're going to focus on?

items.prompt: Listen. According to the coach, what went wrong on the rep?
items.prompt_es: Escucha. Según la coach, ¿qué salió mal en la repetición?
options: His first step was too slow.

speaking.prompt: Coach, I'm up next. Anything I should do on this ground ball?
speaking.prompt_es: Antes de una repetición de roletazo, el jugador te pregunta qué debe hacer. Dale una o dos instrucciones.
speaking.goal: One or two short, clear imperative cues (e.g. stay low, glove out front, move your feet, come get it), with 'your' before body parts and equipment. Band A1–A2.
speaking.goal_es: Una o dos instrucciones cortas y claras (por ejemplo: stay low, glove out front, move your feet), con 'your' delante de las partes del cuerpo.
examples: Stay low and keep your glove out front.
Move your feet and come get it. Glove down early.

speaking.prompt: Coach, what should I focus on during this drill?
speaking.prompt_es: Un jugador te pregunta en qué debe enfocarse durante el ejercicio. Explícale el enfoque y por qué.
speaking.goal: Name one clear focus for the drill and explain why it helps (so, because, that way), optionally checking understanding or asking him to show it. Band B1–B2.
speaking.goal_es: Nombra un enfoque claro para el ejercicio y explica por qué ayuda; si puedes, comprueba que te entendió.
examples: Just focus on your first step. If you read it off the bat and get a quick first step, you'll get a better angle and you won't have to rush the throw.
Today I want you to set your feet before every throw, because that's where your accuracy comes from. Show me on the first one.
